condition: Run only after the fixed E38 development gate passed. No scorer, model, candidate-pool, context, batch or thread changes.
baseline: E35 test-*-baseline.jsonl, where fourgram.enabled=false; verify all current production source/assets/input hashes before reuse.
gate: Each domain top1/top5 nondecreasing, recall unchanged, character errors nonincreasing; combined top1 strictly increases. All gains and losses retained.
scope: These 248+248 states were opened in prior stages; known regression only, not new blind validation. No personal-history, typo, UI or mobile-runtime claim.
stopRule: Freeze this result without changing a score to repair losses. A passing offline test does not authorize direct model deployment; next evaluate lightweight distillation or task-specific trained reranking.
